luci-app-rist2rist.description: Grant UCI, ubus, and file access for rist2rist

unauthenticated.description: rist2rist control for a LAN client holding the bridge's pair token. rpcd's exec interface does not identify the caller, so the plugin verifies the token itself: every method except 'claim' is refused without it, and 'claim' is refused unless the bridge is virgin. Keep this list in step with the plugin's dispatcher.
